name: Joseph Stalin
role: Soviet leader and Communist Party general secretary (1922–1953)
summary: Stalin advocated Communist Party rule, state industrial ownership, central planning and collective agriculture. He defended a strong socialist security state while pursuing industrialisation; his mature social policy promoted the family and restricted abortion and male homosexuality.
